title: sampling weights in the scorer: the review of PR #1200, closed by lane H's rewrite (plan 10 row 10G-37)
note: the findings are the integrator's review of 2026-11-19 16:03 UTC on PR #1200 (not merged); basis as that review states it, and H10G37-01 and -06 re-run here on e25ccc39's score.py; each is closed by the card's code, which did not take the branch

findings.claim: on PR #1200's branch the weighted 95 % interval under-covers when low-probability events go undrawn: 90 certain non-events and 10 events at 0.02 give [0, 0.0402] for a rate of 0.10, missing it in 831 of 1000 seeded draws
on PR #1200's branch a declared sampling frame disappears when the set draws no rows (empty pairs.jsonl, frame of 100: the pair figure is omitted)
on PR #1200's branch the pair scorer keeps a stored wrong-exclusions denominator on a replay that excludes fewer pairs (1/10 instead of 1/1)
on PR #1200's branch the criterion scorer keeps a stored wrong-exclusion denominator on a replay that answers fewer criteria (1/10 instead of 1/5)
on PR #1200's branch the pathology scorer keeps a stored eligible-loss denominator on a replay that answers fewer pairs (1/10 instead of 1/5)
on PR #1200's branch summing inverse weights overflows for accepted tiny probabilities (two events at 1e-308 raise OverflowError)
on PR #1200's branch the replay calls float(None) on a weighted block with no estimated events
on PR #1200's branch the pathology prose gives raw sample counts beside weighted structured fields (1 of 1 beside 4 of 20)
